answer_sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
      WHERE
        order_date BETWEEN CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)
    )
    THEN 'yes'
    ELSE 'no'
  END AS any_sales

value: The 11,121 sale lines (4,641 distinct orders) of contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line whose `order_date` falls in 1 Oct – 31 Dec 2025. Three restrictions, each from a declaration: the period reads `order_date` and not `delivery_date` (`order.default.period_is_order_date`, default `ordered`); "this quarter" anchors on max(order_date) = 2025-12-31 rather than today's 2026-10-24 (`order.resolution.the_anchor_is_the_newest_order`, confidence C, operator ruling 2026-10-23); and the quarter is the calendar one, there being no fiscal calendar in the bundle. No channel predicate was applied — `store.resolution.the_channel_is_the_location_sentinel` scopes its `physical` default with `applies: subject`, and the subject here is sales rather than a Store, so the online row's lines are included. No status predicate, as none is expressible on the sales fact.
